title: A Phase 3 Study to Determine if RTB101 Prevents Clinically Symptomatic Respiratory Illness in the Elderly

sections.abstract:
To determine if RTB101 as compared to placebo decreases the percentage of subjects with clinically symptomatic respiratory illness (with or without an associated laboratory-confirmed pathogen) through Week 16.

Posted outcomes: Percentage of Subjects With Clinically Symptomatic Respiratory Illness. timeframe=Week 0-16. Placebo=125; Dactolisib 10mg Once Daily=134
